title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the automation service's flow reads out of protocol.ts into protocol-automation-flow-reads.ts (#25467 cut 27)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 27 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–26 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449, #26654, #26704, #26807 and #26873. The claim is `6452474807`. It takes the cut 27 proposal of the cut 26 report (`6451437092`), a themed group. All three members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and all three moved unedited.

Three `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into one new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-automation-flow-reads.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the protocol's flow reads from the `automation` service, the engine of this process:

- `resolveFlowCanonicalizer`: the service's `canonicalizeStoredFlow`, bound, for the doors that canonicalize a stored flow body. It returns nothing when the service offers none.
- `resolveFlowRegistrationReader`: the service's `getFlowRegistration`, bound, for a `flow` type only (#23775).
- `flowRegistrationsOf`: the list's `registrations`, that reader's verdict per listed non-draft item (#23316).

`protocol.ts` loses 9 net lines (29,187 to 29,178). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `161e00e4ea` (after cut 26's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `13cd879d32` and two merges of `main`:

- `4581139c4e` (10 commits) brings in #26880, whose `protocol.ts` change (+5) auto-merged.
- `e78313a068` (8 commits) brings in #26856 (+76 / −3 in `protocol.ts`) and #26851. The first merge's derivation reported a STALE TREE on two scripts, so `main` was merged again.

`protocol.ts` auto-merged both times with no conflict. So the merged tree was measured against `main` itself as well (see "The merged tree against `main`").

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

The claim named #26856, #26861 and #26880 as also editing `protocol.ts` and asked for a `git merge-tree` against each before this PR was opened. All three had merged by then:

- **#26880** and **#26856** are in this branch's two merges. Their `protocol.ts` hunks auto-merged, and none of their changed lines falls in the three moved bodies or their stubs.
- **#26861** (the layered read's bundle member selector) merged into `main` after the second merge. It edits `protocol.ts` (+44 / −9 between `main` and this head) and `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`. It names none of the three members. `git merge-tree` of this head with `main` `8074feb642` is clean. On that merged tree:
  - the AST compare against `main`'s `protocol.ts` reads 371 tokens, 0 differ, with 302 class members, 299 byte-identical and 3 stubs;
  - `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0;
  - the tree differs from `main` by this cut alone, 2 files, +123 / −28.

The open PRs were checked against the head `e78313a068` too. Of the 38 open, four touch this package:

- **#26912** edits `protocol.ts` (+703 / −2 over 8 files) and names none of the three. Its merge-tree is clean.
- **#26928** touches one test file. Its merge-tree is clean.
- **#26920** and **#26831** report conflicts, but **not with this cut**. Each conflicts with `main` alone on exactly the same paths, and none of those paths is in this change:
  - #26920: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`;
  - #26831: `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`, `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and `ui/packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts`.

  Against the move commit alone, both are clean.

`main` moved seven commits after the second merge: #26894, #26901, #26905, #26908, #26861, #26913 and #26915. Only #26861 touches this package (above). The derivation on `e78313a068` found nothing stale, so `main` was not merged a third time. The PR's merge ref runs them against this cut.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

All three members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** No body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut: `88 read seam(s)` and an identical list once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resolveFlowCanonicalizer` | `:6585` | private | 12 | 134 | `getServicesRegistry` (field) |
| `resolveFlowRegistrationReader` | `:6693` | private | 7 | 95 | `getServicesRegistry` (field); module-level `canonicalMetaType` |
| `flowRegistrationsOf` | `:6711` | private | 9 | 142 | `resolveFlowRegistrationReader` (method) |

`protocol-automation-flow-reads.ts` has 104 lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–26 apply it)

- **The class keeps all three members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 27]`.
- **`AutomationFlowReadsHost`** types the two members the bodies read as the class members themselves (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['getServicesRegistry']` and `['resolveFlowRegistrationReader']`). Each function's `this` is a `Pick` of the members it reads.
- **`getServicesRegistry`, the constructor-supplied field, is handed over as a getter** (the hand-over of cuts 20, 24 and 26). So each read finds the registry at call time, as before.
- **`flowRegistrationsOf`'s call to `resolveFlowRegistrationReader` is handed over as a closure**, `(...a) => this.resolveFlowRegistrationReader(...a)`, as the order asked. So that call still reaches the class method (now its stub), not the moved function directly.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method:**
  - `resolveFlowCanonicalizer`: 4 callers (`:20784`, `:21680`, `:25284`, `:25575`, base);
  - `resolveFlowRegistrationReader`: `flowRegistrationsOf` and `:11244`;
  - `flowRegistrationsOf`: `:10100`.

  None changes.

## Module-level declarations, by reader: no import leaves `protocol.ts`

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canonicalMetaType` | its own export | yes (22 references at head) | stays; the new module imports it from `./protocol.js`, read at call time only |
| `FlowRegistration` (type) | `@objectstack/spec/api` | yes (the two stubs' declared signatures, and others) | stays; imported as a type too |
| `StoredFlowCanonicalization` (type) | `./stored-migration.js` | yes (the stub's declared return type, and others) | stays; imported as a type too |

So the top level of `protocol.ts` changes by the new module's import alone. No import comment moves.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut**, including on the merged tree against `main`. The cut adds one import statement and its comment ahead of every class docblock, so the cut 25 comment-offset trap was watched. It did not fire: the raw hash is identical at both ends.

Base `161e00e4ea` and head `13cd879d32` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `c5edca148ff159d4ee49cb2a2b739a2db8695df0267142816c084fb94ca80dce` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `455d53280fb9c9226324aeb678e5da84e5a0efae88a4bf210d35c4405942d1b5` at both ends, 777,661 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `c9423dc904760728…` at base and `2dcd91000df2937a…` at head (`index.cjs` `599562da548797ec…` → `362063271dc2cdba…`).
  - `….call(host` goes 0 → 1 for each of the three members in both bundles.
  - Each `function …(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `resolveFlowRegistrationReader` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `409763bd3a5619d6…` (normalised `2856b5a8fc02c6ba…`, which differs from the bar's `c5edca14…`) and print `resolveFlowRegistrationReader(type: string): ((name: string) => FlowRegistration) | undefined;`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the three functions, and not `AutomationFlowReadsHost`, appears.

### The merged tree against `main`

The merges brought in #26880's and #26856's `protocol.ts` changes, so the merged tree `e78313a068` was measured against `main` `57820085fa`, its second parent, in the same way. The closure was rebuilt by a full `pnpm build` (116/116), and `main`'s package `src/` was swapped in tree-only and restored under a trap. The merged tree differs from `main` only by this cut: 2 files, +123 / −28.

- **`.d.ts`**: raw `4f48a58b638106f9…` (779,140 bytes) and normalised `6b3acbaf32ddd812…`, the same at `main` and merged. Both identities hold.
- **`index.js`**: `9c5d5525453d5395…` at `main`, `3f469d2dc9064d24…` merged. Export tables: 78 names, `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on both.
- **AST compare**, `main`'s `protocol.ts` against the merged one: 371 tokens, 0 differ.
- **Suite**: `main` and merged both give 21,719 tests (21,693 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped, 277 files), per test identical.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `88 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (164 lines, and no entry changes file).

- None of the three bodies has a `try`, and none reads the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`).
- No seam enters or leaves the census.
- On the merged tree the list is identical too, and the verdict still reads `88 read seam(s)`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `161e00e4ea` against the head module:

```
resolveFlowCanonicalizer: base tokens 134, head tokens 134, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
resolveFlowRegistrationReader: base tokens 95, head tokens 95, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
flowRegistrationsOf: base tokens 142, head tokens 142, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=371 differ=0 members=3
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=298 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=3 other=[]
TOP base=259 head=260 byte-identical=259
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module, and only the mutated member moved (differ 1; the other two stayed 0):

```
"typeof canonicalize !== 'function'"      -> "… !== 'object'"   resolveFlowCanonicalizer differ 1
"canonicalMetaType(type) !== 'flow'"      -> "… !== 'view'"     resolveFlowRegistrationReader differ 1
"typeof name !== 'string'"                -> "… !== 'number'"   flowRegistrationsOf differ 1
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 298 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. All three stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 259 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +123 / −28 over 2 files, 151 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 140–190).

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path, the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/`, `scripts/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers were grepped for the three member names.

- **By path: none reads a moved line.** The only hits outside the two source files are comments: the header of `protocol.flow-canonicalizer.test.ts` and a docblock in `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`. The two CHANGELOGs also mention them.
- **Behaviour, no edit owed.** `protocol.flow-canonicalizer.test.ts` drives `resolveFlowCanonicalizer` through the protocol's doors. It passes at both ends, in the package suite.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at any of the three. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). These are `packages/spec/**`, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 with identical output at both ends (1,897 decision-letter citations, 60,008 citations). No moved line cites an ADR.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13898 → 13889, 13923 → 13914).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,810 at base and 3,812 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–26.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `161e00e4ea`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head, on the merged tree, and on the merge-tree with `main` `8074feb642`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `161e00e4ea`: 21,692 tests (21,666 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 274 files.
  - Head `13cd879d32`: 21,692 tests (21,666 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 274 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `161e00e4ea` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `e78313a068` and `main` `57820085fa` both give 21,719 tests, per test identical (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 31 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 151 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `e78313a068`, with no stale-tree finding. All 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21): `findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`, `isArtifactBacked` and `isNestedArtifactField` (the `lookupArtifactItem` site pins), and `getOverlayRepo`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable` and `resolveSduiManifest`.
